targets.label: Process Studies (Center for Process Studies)
targets.message:
Dear Editors,

I am theodoreyong9, and I am writing about "Value: An Ontology of the Sustainable Residue", a short essay (about 6,800 words, 14 pages) that defines value as what a relation leaves behind when it has a real cost and that cost remains sustainable. It is built on relational and process ontology: the essay argues that no term precedes relation, with Whitehead, Simondon and Rovelli as its reference points, so it speaks to the readers of your journal.

The essay is here: https://github.com/theodoreyong9/Aiwa_app/releases/tag/docs-valeur

Would you consider it for review, or tell me which form (article, discussion note) would suit it best?

Thank you for your time.

theodoreyong9

targets.message:
Dear Editors,

I am theodoreyong9, and I am writing about "Value: An Ontology of the Sustainable Residue", a short essay (about 6,800 words, 14 pages) that defines value as what a relation leaves behind when it has a real cost and that cost remains sustainable. Your call on process social ontologies asks for work that builds on or employs a process view of the social; the essay does so for value, in its economic, social and conscious domains, with Graeber and Marx among its references.

The essay is here: https://github.com/theodoreyong9/Aiwa_app/releases/tag/docs-valeur

Is this call still open, and could the essay be considered for it?

Thank you for your time.

theodoreyong9

targets.label: The Journal of Value Inquiry (editor-in-chief: John Hacker-Wright)
targets.message:
Dear Editors,

I am theodoreyong9, and I am writing about "Value: An Ontology of the Sustainable Residue", a short essay (about 6,800 words, 14 pages) that defines value as what a relation leaves behind when it has a real cost and that cost remains sustainable. Its question is what value is and under what condition it exists, and it also states what would refute it (section XI), which is why I send it to a journal devoted to value inquiry.

The essay is here: https://github.com/theodoreyong9/Aiwa_app/releases/tag/docs-valeur

I will submit it as a regular paper through your submission page unless you advise another route.

Thank you for your time.

theodoreyong9
